failures.reason: The old fixture combined an unavailable 3.8 model with a changed world. In 3.14 the version-availability gate rejects first; that rejection cannot prove or disprove current-model geometry safety.
The 3.9-to-current test still expected the declared 3.9-to-3.13 migration to apply to 3.14.
The 3.9/3.10/3.11-to-current test still assumed all future destinations had a complete-state migrator.
The 3.12-to-3.13 migration contract was still asserted for 3.14, which adds research-height control state and changes city geometry without declaring a public historical full-state mapping.

acceptanceRevision.notChanged: No migrator was added and no model, geometry, state, parameter or refusal check in runtime was weakened. No public historical snapshot was relabelled to pass the current contract.
acceptanceRevision.history: Assert exact refusal messages for both exact replay and explicit recomputation; zero physical import and zero integration; original fixture and archive bytes, record identity, parameters, state and journals remain readable and exportable.
acceptanceRevision.currentModel: Generate genuine current-model physical records; independently corrupt only geometry, one parameter, or one controller-state field and require the corresponding exact error with unchanged destination and zero integration. Preserve the separate unknown-build/current-model explicit recomputation success case.
acceptanceRevision.futureGate: Shared no-migrator assertions explicitly require MODEL_VERSION 3.14.0 so a future version cannot silently inherit this acceptance policy.

targetedRerun.scope: Targeted numerical and byte-preservation regressions only; not a rerun or completion claim for the full aggregate.
